node.statement: By lem-routef-raw-factor-setting-formation, choose its one global scalar header W_RF before the input; for the fixed admissible (H,Phi,eta), choose the resulting datum S. Thus B is a finite-dimensional unital C*-algebra, Phi is UCP, tilde-Delta=iota_{A subseteq B(H)} o v, v is an extended C_E*epsilon_AI(eta)-isomorphism, and all scalar notation is exactly (1.1)-(1.8) of def-routef-raw-factor-setting.
